turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Doctor, over the past few months I’ve had increasing stiffness in my arm, and it’s been harder to comb my hair and reach up to high shelves. I also notice my shoulder range of motion is decreased, and my arm strength feels around 4 out of 5. ”

turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, yes—my arm feels quite stiff when I first wake up, and I notice it’s harder to move smoothly at the start of the day. After I get going it loosens somewhat, but combing my hair and reaching high shelves are still difficult. ”
